mapper.select: SELECT JSONExtractString(ifNull(row.metadata, '{}'), 'slide_key') AS slide_key, JSONExtractBool(ifNull(row.metadata, '{}'), 'can_serve_tiles') AS can_serve_tiles, JSONExtractString(ifNull(row.metadata, '{}'), 'wsi_serving', 'sealed_source') AS sealed_source, JSONExtractRaw(ifNull(row.metadata, '{}'), 'wsi_serving', 'tile_metadata_json') AS tile_metadata_json, JSONExtract(ifNull(row.metadata, '{}'), 'wsi_serving', 'thumbnail_width', 'Nullable(UInt32)') AS thumbnail_width, JSONExtract(ifNull(row.metadata, '{}'), 'wsi_serving', 'thumbnail_height', 'Nullable(UInt32)') AS thumbnail_height, JSONExtractString(ifNull(row.metadata, '{}'), 'wsi_serving', 'thumbnail_content_type') AS thumbnail_content_type FROM resource_data row PREWHERE row.cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND row.resource_id IN ('WSI_SAMPLE', 'WSI_PATIENT') AND row.patient_id = #{patientId} WHERE row.type = 'WHOLE_SLIDE_IMAGE' AND JSONExtractString(ifNull(row.metadata, '{}'), 'slide_key') = #{slideKey} LIMIT 1
